title: Papa John Joseph's death and playing trio with him and George Lewis
summary: Guesnon recounts how Papa John Joseph overexerted himself, shows a photo of the trio, and says he died at 90 in 1964.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
